lines.say: An inequality describes a whole range of values, not just one.
At least 120 centimetres tall means 120 or any height above it.
Less than, and greater than.
Less than or equal to, and greater than or equal to.
An open circle means the end number is not included.
lines.alt: Number line showing x > 3 with an open circle at 3 and an arrow pointing right

lines.say: A closed, filled-in circle means the number is included.
lines.alt: Number line showing x ≤ −4 with a closed circle at −4 and an arrow pointing left

lines.say: Filled circle, filled in. The arrow shows all the other solutions.
Solve 4x minus 3 is greater than 9.
Add 3 to both sides.
Divide both sides by 4. It's positive, so the sign stays the same.
Check with 4. 16 minus 3 is 13, and 13 is more than 9.
2 is less than 5. 2 is to the left of 5.

draw.alt: Number line from −6 to 6 with 2 and 5 marked

lines.say: Multiply both by minus 1. Now minus 2 is greater than minus 5.

draw.alt: Both numbers flip to the other side of zero, so the order swaps

lines.say: Multiplying by a negative swaps the order. So reverse the sign.
Adding and subtracting never flip the sign.
Solve 5 minus 3x is at least 17.
Subtract 5 from both sides.
Divide by minus 3, and flip the sign.

draw.alt: The greater-than-or-equal sign is crossed out and replaced by less-than-or-equal

lines.say: Test minus 5. 5 plus 15 is 20, which is at least 17.
Tip. Keep the x term positive and you never need to flip.
This has three parts. Do every step to all three.
Subtract 1 from all three parts.
Divide all three by 2. x is between minus 2 and 3.
lines.alt: Number line showing −2 < x ≤ 3: open circle at −2, closed circle at 3

lines.say: The whole numbers are minus 1, 0, 1, 2 and 3. Minus 2 is not included.
Don't forget to flip after dividing by a negative.
Don't flip when you add or subtract a negative.
Change all three parts of a double inequality.
Rewrite 4 less than x as x greater than 4 before drawing.
Negative times or divide? Flip the sign.
Closed circle for included. Open circle for not included.
Test one number inside and one outside your answer.
If you forget, try the 2 and 5 test.
